notes.title: March 17th update, take two
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] - Restored the March 17th update.
[*] - Fixed a bug where the creature was getting stuck invisible when she would need to teleport instead.
[*] - Fixed a bug where the creature would sometimes run away after the player looked at her for too long, even if she needed to run towards the player instead. 
[*] - Potentially fixed the issue where the ending cutscene would not start.
[/list]

notes.title: Temporarily build revert
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Apologies for the people who downloaded the game today.
It seems the last patch introduced a few game-breaking bugs, so I temporarily reverted those changes while we're investigating what went wrong.

I should be able to push the update back shortly, but for the record, here's which bugs were introduced (and are getting fixed when I'll submit the last patch again) :

- The monster would stay completely stuck in place, nullifying any possible threat.
- The ending cutscene doesn't play, it simply cuts to black.

Very sorry once more, I should be able to push everything back not too long from now.

notes.title: Patch notes - March 17th, 2021
notes.notes:
[h2]FIXED : [/h2]
[list]
[*] Pushed a new lighting build, this should drastically increase performance.
[*] Fixed a French translation error in the main menu.
[*] Added subtitles to the introduction cutscene.
[*] Increased the delay between texts within the introduction cutscene.
[*] Added independent audio settings for cutscenes.
[*] Further tweaked the game audio.
[*] Potentially fixed a bug where not ending the introduction cutscene prematurely would cause a black screen.
[*] Fixed some setting values that would reset upon exiting the menu. This was a purely visual bug.
[*] Combined mouse sensitivity X and Y values.
[*] Added the option of inverting mouse X and Y inputs, for aspiring pilots out there.
[*] Added video settings for depth of field and motion blur.
[*] Drastically increased the radius of Mirror Image.
[*] Drastically decreased the range at which the monster can teleport.
[*] Added a slider in the gameplay settings for people who can't stand being blinded by the holy light.
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN BUGS / POSSIBLE IMPROVEMENTS :[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game does not save upon exit. We originally had intended for it to be this way when we realized we wouldn't be producing anything more than a proof of concept, but it's definitely something I can look into - it shouldn't be overly complicated.
[*] The UI seems to disappear at some random points in the game. It doesn't happen every single time, and I haven't been able to reproduce the issue, but I'll keep searching!
[*] The ingredient loss penalty on death is too harsh. We'll try and have the ingredient progression be saved at each checkpoint instead.
[*] There's no UI to indicate how many keys have been collected! This could cause confusion after dying in the main area, since it wasn't obvious that these keys were lost.
[/list]

notes.title: Day "one" patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry about the awkward silence following our game's release. Many thanks to everyone who showed interest in our project, you guys are the reason why we've decided to push it slightly further than we originally intended.

We've taken a short break (after what feels like a 7-month game jam, it was about time), and we've assessed a few improvements that we would like to make during the coming week(s):

[list]
[*] [b]Performance[/b]. It's nowhere near perfect, and though we don't expect that it'll make a massive difference, we're going to try a few things to make the experience a tad more enjoyable for lower-end devices.
[*] [b]Menus[/b]. The settings menu appears to not save the current selection, but it indeed does - there's a visual bug which appears to reset the selection after exiting. We're investigating the issue, and should come up with a fix fairly soon.
[*] [b]Subtitles[/b]. We're still missing some during cut-scenes due to the lack of time with our strict deadlines, and thus, we'd like to solve this accessibility issue as soon as possible.
[/list]

And a few more, smaller fixes. I won't bore you with the details here, but we'd like this experience to be enjoyable for as many people as possible.

I'll take this moment to address a few commonly asked questions : 

[b]Q: What is this game? Is it a demo?[/b]
A: Yes and no. This was originally meant to be a full experience, but we had to cut some corners during development (literally three whole levels). The narration suffered greatly, but we managed to keep various important elements whilst hinting toward a possible story line that would've properly tied everything together. I'll leave it up to your imagination! For the record, this was indeed a school project made by a team of a dozen artists and sound designers. (UQAT & UdeM!)

[b]Q: Who's the monster?[/b]
A: Now, I don't exactly want to spoil the game! Figuring that out is part of the fun. But here's a hint - her name is Melody, not Daddy LongLegs! 

[b]Q: Is VR a planned feature?[/b]
A: We've strongly considered it for a while, but again, the academic nature of the project made it so we had to cut many corners to instead try and provide a polished experience within the required deadlines. We're kinda breaking that rule with the incoming patches, but we can't take this too far.

[b]Q: Is the project going to be further developed?[/b]
A: As previously mentioned, we can't take development too far since most of the team is going to be disbanded from this point onward. This has been a truly amazing experience, but most of us are now hunting for actual professional jobs, this project marking the end of our Bachelor's degree. I'm sorry to say, any possible continuation is going to have to be abandoned.
